steps.script:
tell application "Calendar"
	set startDate to current date
	set endDate to startDate + (7 * days)
	set output to ""
	repeat with c in every calendar
		set upcoming to (every event of c whose start date >= startDate and start date <= endDate)
		repeat with e in upcoming
			set output to output & name of c & ": " & summary of e & " -- " & start date of e & linefeed
		end repeat
	end repeat
	if output is "" then return "No events this week"
	return output
end tell
